signs.text: SPAR CAVE. A cave on the Strathaird shore, lined with calcite that shines like glass. Walter Scott visited in 1814 and wrote of it in The Lord of the Isles. The sea fills the mouth at high water.

text: The floor climbs in pale, glassy steps, like a waterfall that was told to stand still. Your light runs over it like a wet finger.
On a dry ledge above the spray, a ballad sheet wrapped in chip paper. Even a sea cave has its day trippers.
